title: Ionizable Lipid Nanoparticles and Nucleoside Modification for mRNA Therapeutics
pre_discovery_prompt: Exogenous synthetic mRNA injected into living tissue is immediately destroyed by extracellular nucleases and triggers lethal Toll-like receptor innate immune reactions. How can mRNA be safely encapsulated and delivered intact into cytoplasm?
ground_truth_finding: Replacement of uridine with N1-methylpseudouridine to bypass TLR detection, combined with ionizable amino lipid nanoparticles that become positively charged at acidic endosomal pH to facilitate cytosolic release.
notes_on_reconstruction: Stripped Pfizer/BioNTech/Moderna brand names and COVID vaccine terminology.
